title: CueClash: Frontier Vision-Language Models Judge 3-D Relations Close to the Picture Plane
abstract: arXiv:2611.22180v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A vision-language model (VLM) can judge 3-D relations from the picture or from the ground layout. In photographs the two usually agree. We separate them with CueClash, rendered scenes in which the 2-D cue for each of five relations is right on exactly half the statements. The shortcut gap is accuracy when the cue is right minus accuracy when it is wrong. For Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.6 Flash at low reasoning effort it is +18 to +37 percentage points. It is +7 to +29 without two relations whose cue-wrong items are confounded with borderline cases or occlusion. Given ground coordinates and each relation's definition, they answer 99 to 100% correctly. Pixel measurements with camera depths remove most of the gap for objects fitting through openings. The failure lies in the step from the picture to the layout. The maps that the models draw of the scene from above mostly keep the depth order but, like the picture, shorten depth.

translated_title: CueClash：前沿视觉语言模型依据贴近图像平面的线索判断三维关系
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）可以从图像画面或从地面布局来判断三维关系。在真实照片中，两者通常是一致的。我们通过 CueClash 将二者分离——这是一组渲染场景，其中五种关系各自的二维线索恰好在一半的陈述上是正确的。捷径差距（shortcut gap）定义为线索正确时的准确率减去线索错误时的准确率。在低推理强度下，Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-5.5 和 Gemini 3.6 Flash 的捷径差距为 +18 至 +37 个百分点。若剔除两种其线索错误条目与临界情形或遮挡相混淆的关系，该差距为 +7 至 +29 个百分点。若给出地面坐标和各关系的定义，它们的回答正确率可达 99% 到 100%。对于能够穿过开口的物体，结合相机深度的像素测量可消除大部分差距。失败发生在从画面到布局的转换这一步：模型从上方俯视绘制的场景地图大多保留了深度顺序，但与画面一样缩短了深度。
tldr: 研究提出 CueClash 基准，揭示前沿视觉语言模型在判断三维关系时严重依赖二维图像捷径线索而非真实空间布局（捷径差距高达 +18 至 +37 个百分点），其失败源于从画面到地面布局的推理步骤。
en_tdlr: CueClash reveals that frontier vision-language models judge 3-D relations by relying on 2-D picture-plane cues over true ground layout, with shortcut gaps of +18 to +37 percentage points, and the failure lies in the step from picture to layout.
